question: Should CodexBar accept ai& as a supported spend-only provider after the architecture, path, conflict, and proof blockers are resolved?
rationale: A new provider and credential surface requires product acceptance; the related proposal issues describe evaluation criteria but do not explicitly approve ai&.

options.title: Accept after blockers
options.body: Sponsor ai& once it is rebased onto macro registration, uses the resolved config path, and demonstrates funded-account behavior.

options.title: Decline provider scope
options.body: Do not add ai& if its user demand or long-term maintenance expectations do not meet CodexBar's provider bar.

recommendation.title: Accept after blockers
recommendation.body: Sponsor ai& once it is rebased onto macro registration, uses the resolved config path, and demonstrates funded-account behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available owner for both provider architecture and the decision to support another provider.
